why: The marshal's muster faces south, and the route brings the party to him from the north: without his `watch` the party walks up to his back to answer him (162 degrees off his facing). It declares no unit: a body may face any way and may watch or not, and what the engine refuses is a body the party talks to that faces away from them as they come into reach. Before this refusal the build was green, and characters stood with their backs to the player when approached.
